title: USP ACP Booking Extension
description: Schema for the dev.usp-protocol.services.booking ACP extension. Adds a `booking` field to CheckoutSession carrying scheduling context from USP. See specification Section 8.5.6.

service_type.description: USP service vertical. MUST match Service.type (core verticals: appointment, group, reservation, rental) or a vendor-defined vertical per USP catalog.

slot.description: Booked time range. Simplified from USP SlotReference (start/end only; omits id and duration).
